title: Chapter 222: Don't Be Afraid!
html:
“Why are they following us?” Xiao Du’s voice trembled. He stood closest to the cluster of mannequins.

“Did you hear any footsteps?” Han Qiuming shifted his gaze to Xiao Du. “Moving that many mannequins would require more than one worker hidden among them.”

“There wasn’t a sound. It was as if they suddenly appeared behind us—I swear.” Xiao Du spoke quickly, afraid that Han Qiuming would not believe him.

“No sound?” Han Qiuming’s brows drew together. He studied the mannequins for a moment, then abruptly laughed. “I’ve figured it out!”

He strode toward the mannequins as though he had truly uncovered their secret. “The floor of the Third Sick Hall is covered in mattresses. If the workers step on those, their footsteps won’t make a sound. The designer is clever. He hid dolls beneath the mattresses to draw our attention and make us overlook their real purpose.”

Han Qiuming stopped beside the female mannequin, a smug smile on his lips. “Using mattresses to muffle footsteps is an excellent idea, but your clumsy execution gave the trick away. If you want to put visitors under psychological pressure, you must maintain a safe distance—close enough for them to sense your presence, but not close enough to touch you.”

Xiao Du did not quite follow. “Why is that best? Having them close in on me like this is much scarier.”

“Push too far and you’ll provoke the opposite reaction. Visitors might do something like this.” Han Qiuming tore the mannequin’s head off and shoved its body to the floor. Facing the cluster in the dark corridor, he shouted, “Come out on your own. Don’t make me drag you out—that will only embarrass everyone.”

“Who are you talking to?” Xiao Du could no longer follow his reasoning.

“The workers in the Third Sick Hall. They’re wearing special makeup and hiding among the mannequins!” Han Qiuming adjusted his glasses, his expression proclaiming that everything was under control.

Ten seconds passed, yet none of the mannequins moved. The shadowy figures remained perfectly still in the dark corridor, and their absolute stillness was unsettling in its own way.

“Mr. Han, shouldn’t we move on? If the workers don’t want to come out, just leave them alone,” Xiao Du advised. But Han Qiuming took the suggestion as an affront to his pride. “Once I’ve exposed them, it’s no longer their choice. They’re unlucky I’m in such a foul mood today. That Chen fellow wrecked our Haunted House, didn’t he? Today, I’ll return the favor and wreak havoc in his!”

Han Qiuming marched into the cluster of mannequins. One by one, he tore off their heads and kicked their bodies to the ground. “Fine, keep hiding. Let’s see how long you can hold out!”

The heads rolling across the floor made the scene even more macabre.

“Please come back, Mr. Han!” Xiao Du’s heart raced as he watched the mannequin heads tumble past.

“Why are you so anxious?” Han Qiuming had already wrenched off five heads. “This worker is certainly loyal. He’d rather watch the props be destroyed than come out and surrender.”

“Boss and Brother Song are far ahead. We need to catch up!” Xiao Du urged him. More heads rolled across the floor, and his scalp tingled as their expressions seemed to change. They were smiling.

“Don’t panic!” By the time Han Qiuming tore off the eighth head, even he sensed that something was wrong. “These mannequins have metal joints and frames. An adult would struggle to move four at once. Could the workers be hiding at the rear of the group? That must be it. Even with special makeup, they would be exposed if they came too close, so they have to be in the back!”

Having convinced himself, Han Qiuming charged ahead, knocking mannequins aside in every direction.

“Mr. Han!” Xiao Du watched anxiously as Han Qiuming plunged into the cluster alone. Gritting his teeth, he ran after him. “Let’s go! We shouldn’t destroy so many expensive props.”

“If he dares wreck our Haunted House, he should be prepared for the consequences.” Han Qiuming strode toward the final four mannequins lying on the floor. “You’re making me do this.”

He gripped one of the remaining four and gave a light tug. Its head came off with ease.

“That one’s a mannequin too?” Xiao Du’s voice shook. “Mr. Han, are you sure they weren’t moving by themselves? When I came over, I swear the expressions on their faces changed.”

“What do you know? Be quiet!” Han Qiuming tore the heads from two more mannequins. When his hands closed around the last one, they began to tremble. He pulled hard, wrenching a tearful face from its body.

“What the f*ck?!”

Head in hand, Han Qiuming stared at Xiao Du.

“They’re all mannequins?” Xiao Du’s voice quavered. Standing amid the graveyard of dismembered figures, he did not dare move.

“Don’t be afraid! The workers must have hidden in the sickrooms on either side when they saw me coming.” Han Qiuming dropped the head and rushed to inspect the rooms. “Come out! I’ve already seen you!”

He searched several rooms but found nothing. Han Qiuming returned with a grim expression.

“Mr. Han, do you think this place might really be haunted? Boss Chen is a madman. He’ll do anything. He trapped me inside a steel box once.” Goosebumps covered Xiao Du’s skin as he began recounting his nightmarish experience.

“Enough. That’s nothing to boast about.” Han Qiuming cut him off with a wave, mentally measuring the distance from the corridor to the Third Sick Hall’s entrance. “After moving the mannequins, the workers wouldn’t have had enough time to escape through the entrance. Yes, I understand now. They must have used a staff passage. There’s probably a hidden tunnel beneath one of these mattresses.”

No matter what Han Qiuming said, Xiao Du no longer believed him. He only wanted to put as much distance between himself and Mr. Han as possible. Staying near the man could not lead to anything good.

“If you want to search for it, be my guest. I’m leaving.” Xiao Du turned and ran.

“With courage like that, no wonder a visitor frightened him.” The confidence had vanished from Han Qiuming’s voice, however. As he set off after the group, a headless mannequin’s finger snagged his trouser leg. He immediately kicked it aside. “Who are you trying to scare?”

After rounding the corner, Han Qiuming heard objects rolling across the floor behind him. “So fake.”

He did not look back. Instead, he quickened his pace to catch up with the others.
